name: thrift
description: KOZMOS Thrift: a frugal mode. /thrift on|off|auto; while on, every prompt carries a short note asking Claude to be economical (targeted reads, no broad searches or subagents unless needed, concise answers). Auto turns it on when the 5-hour or weekly limit passes autoAt and off after the window resets. A band with a spinning coin, and /thrift compares the average cost of thrift turns with normal ones.

autoAt.title: Auto at (%)
autoAt.description: In auto mode, thrift turns on when the 5-hour or weekly limit passes this percent.
